summary: This bill amends the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act to prevent insurance payments from being considered a duplication of benefits when determining eligibility for disaster displacement assistance, such as hotel stays or other housing options.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Stafford Act to prevent insurance from being considered a duplication of benefits for certain disaster displacement assistance. This change could lead to increased federal spending on disaster relief as more individuals may become eligible for assistance, even if they have insurance.
